output_contract.notes: The agent must run DFT calculations at the ωB97X‑D/Def2‑TZVPP level with a 0.950 frequency scaling factor. Scored outputs are JSON arrays; the checker compares computed values against reference values derived from the same computational protocol and verifies required qualitative trends (high‑spin lowest, penta‑coordinated lowest, OCO frequency ordering). Absolute tolerances absorb legitimate method‑dependent shifts.
